facts.activity_file: working in dust, darkness and weather restrictions

control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
positive communication before approaching mobile equipment
segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: trapped hazardous energy found after isolation of HT-9006

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control POSITIVE_COMMUNICATION_BEFORE_APPROACH: the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment on HT-9006 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment on HT-9006 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating in reduced visibility, specifically working in dust, darkness and weather restrictions. HT-9006 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 15 January 2017 a potential incident was recorded on HT-9006 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during an intrusive maintenance task; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
